intelligence.enrichment: Health is complete physical, mental, and social well-being, not merely the absence of disease. Balanced body, mind, social life, and surroundings support health; loneliness, poor habits, or poor surroundings reduce well-being. The learner correctly applies this rule: Health is complete physical, mental, and social well-being, not merely the absence of disease. A person with no named disease is healthy, even if the person is lonely and cannot sleep well.
